system.description:
One of the rarest and least-taught Valeren powers, Heaven's Gate infuses a recently dead cadaver with the power of life itself, without Embracing or ghouling the target. Spectators can see the departing soul drawn back through the golden glow of the Salubri's third eye. Salubri are loath to use this power, for many reasons.

System: The Salubri lays hands on the recently dead and, spending 2 Willpower and rolling Willpower (difficulty 8), draws the fleeing soul back into its body. Unless the body is healed or revitalized soon after, death will likely return swiftly. Heaven's Gate cannot be used more than 10 minutes after the victim's last heartbeat, and a botch may draw back a very different sort of spirit, at the Storyteller's discretion.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
